content.title: Taxable income becomes $1 immediately above the Single standard deduction boundary
content.intent: Prove the taxable-income calculation crosses from zero to a positive whole-dollar amount immediately above the deduction threshold.
content.technique_notes: Applied boundary value analysis to the floor-at-zero rule and isolated 14601 from the authority expansion around 14600 because the expected taxable income changes from zero to positive. Risk-judged interaction strength was 3 because money applies, but no covering array was used because this is a single boundary-crossing check on one calculation input.
